segments.text: Philippine news in eighty seconds. Three updates, checked October third.
First, GCash parent company Mynt has set its initial public offering price at six pesos and sixty centavos per share.
GMA News reports the planned Philippine Stock Exchange listing is October twentieth.
The company says the timetable remains subject to approvals and other conditions.
Second, the Climate Change Commission is calling for stronger preparation as El Nino could intensify before the end of this year.
In an October second release carried by the Philippine Information Agency, it urged decisions guided by science, data, and risk information.
The advisory highlights risks of below normal rainfall, dry spells, and drought in some areas.
Third, Jeus Gabriel Derick Yape won gold in mixed individual virtual taekwondo at the Asian Games in Japan.
The Olympic Council of Asia reports that he beat his Vietnamese opponent two rounds to zero in the final.
He had won a poomsae bronze the previous day.
This was the Philippines fourth gold medal at these Games, after two from Carlos Yulo and one from E J Obiena.
Read the original source links in the description for more details.
